title: Presales Executive
description:
Greetings From SAFAL INFOSOFT LTD!!!

We are looking for a motivated and confident **Presales Executive** to join our team on a Work-from-Home basis. The ideal candidate should have experience in **Presales, Sales Coordination, or a similar role**, along with strong communication and interpersonal skills.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Handle presales activities and coordinate with the sales team.
* Communicate with prospective clients and understand their requirements.
* Prepare and share product/service information, quotations, and proposals.
* Coordinate with internal teams to support the sales process.
* Follow up with leads and prospective clients.
* Maintain proper records of leads, follow-ups, and client communication.
* Assist the sales team in achieving business targets.
* Conduct product/service discussions and basic demonstrations when required.

**Requirements:**

* 1–2 years of experience in **Presales / Sales Coordination / Business Development**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Good interpersonal and client-handling skills.
* Experience in **Software / ERP Sales** will be preferred.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office/Google Workspace.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively in a Work-from-Home environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field.
* 1–2 years of experience in Presales, Sales Coordination, or Business Development.

If are you interested for this profile please share your update cv on hr@safalinfosoft.com

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person
